events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is showing signs of escalation, with both sides engaging in military actions. This has led to increased tensions in the region and a rise in oil prices. The situation is being closely monitored by global leaders, with many calling for a peaceful resolution.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict in Iran has led to increased volatility in the markets, with oil prices rising and stocks experiencing a downturn. However, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is expected to bounce back as the US economy remains strong. On the other hand, the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) is expected to decline as the conflict disrupts oil production and prices rise.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the conflict is resolved or if oil prices drop significantly

gains.conservativeNote: If the conflict is resolved quickly
